audit.why: 48.81% over 1096 games with an EVEN tag and 6/10 difficulty is fair — Mundo is slightly behind, and the lane is decided by terrain choice rather than by stats.

audit.whatIsWrong: The chart handed Mundo Level 6, First item and 2+ items while every prose field on those rows says the opposite: whys[4] 'Level 6 favours her', whys[5] 'keeping her ahead', whys[6] 'it becomes a skill matchup'. The packet levelChart also reads Illaoi x6 then Skill.
audit.why: Illaoi's power is continuous, not spiky, and Mundo's ultimate does not out-pace a tentacle ring that heals her on every hit. The one stage that genuinely evens out is two items.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Illaoi / Illaoi / Illaoi / Illaoi / Illaoi / Illaoi / Skill across win[] and phases[].side as one atomic group, ratings rescaled, and phases[2..6].why rewritten so the row text stops promising a flip that does not happen.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly asserts Illaoi's tentacles deal '% max-HP damage' and 'hit harder the tankier you are' (spikes[0], spikes[2], whys[3], early, wants.foe[0]). Riot's own text says tentacles deal physical damage and heal Illaoi when they damage a champion — there is no percent-health component in the kit and no percentHealth flag on any Illaoi ability, while the same generator does flag it on Mundo's R. Two real interactions were absent instead: tentacle hits HEAL her (Prophet of an Elder God), and Harsh Lesson is a 4-second-cooldown dash and auto reset that makes every nearby tentacle swing at the target.
audit.why: The false version tells a Mundo player his own build is the problem; the true version tells him to buy Grievous Wounds and fight away from walls, which is the actual counterplay.
audit.corrected: Reframed to tentacle healing plus Grievous Wounds timing in spikes[2], phases[5].why and wants.foe[0]; Harsh Lesson's 4s dash named in phases[3].why; Test of Spirit's Vessel condition (die to the spirit or walk too far from it) stated in phases[2].why, breakdown.cooldowns and report[5].

audit.whatIsWrong: Test of Spirit given as a flat '16s'.
audit.why: It is 16/15/14/13/12 — 16s is only the rank-1 value, and by the time you are deciding to step up it is nearer 12s.

notes: UNVERIFIED, deliberately not written to the page: the kit generator flags Leap of Faith with 'untargetable' and 'grounding', and missingInteractions repeats the untargetable claim, but Riot's own description of Leap of Faith mentions neither — it only smashes, damages, and spawns a tentacle per champion hit. Per the calibration rule I trusted the description and asserted nothing about untargetability or grounding. Someone should confirm on the wiki before it is written anywhere. Same caution applied to the '% max-HP tentacle damage' claim that runs through this matchup's prose: no Illaoi ability carries a percentHealth flag and Riot's text says physical damage, so I rewrote toward the verifiable fact (tentacles heal her on champion hits) instead of asserting the negative. spikes[0].text, whys[3] and early still contain the % max-HP phrasing and should be revisited once someone confirms the ratio. tradeGood and breakdown.trading carry scraped PDF junk ('• • Dr. Mundo Top Lane Matchup Database 91').
